{steps of hiring}

Our Technical Interview Process

{ Stage 1 }

Discussion

Tell us about your technical interview outsourcing needs, provide requirements or the scope of tech skills you need to assess. We will immediately check our internal talent pool, conduct market research.

{ Stage 2 }

Validation

Mobilunity’s team will validate the potentially fitting candidates, their hard and soft skills, based on the specific requirements for their role. We conduct interviews to evaluate the most promising ones.

{ Stage 3 }

 Interviewing

We bring the best candidates selected for the final rounds of interviews in front of you. We guide you through the process, offering detailed feedback and evaluation scoring for potential matches.

{ Stage 4}

Post-Interview

Once the ideal candidate is chosen, we double-check the alignment with your requirements. Our HR team makes a job offer and helps you prepare a contract with all terms and conditions.

Get My Team Estimate

{challenges}

Challenges You Can Solve

Lack of Qualified Interviewers

Struggling to find the perfect technical interviewers and recruiters often leads to low-quality candidate assessments and can potentially drive costly hiring mistakes.

Slow Hiring Cycle

Busy team members will get unproductive when handling large volumes of interviewing. This can lead to delays in filling positions, and inability to get a highly-demanded yet rare expertise.

Excessive Hiring Costs

Maintaining a professional hiring team in-house instead of getting service on-demand – right when you need it. Outsourcing to specialized vendors will significantly optimize your budget.

Inaccurate Interview Evaluations

Human factors and variability in interviewer expertise can make assessments inaccurate. Professional services reduce bias and ensure evaluations are standardized, consistent, and fair.

Difficulty Scaling

It’s hard to meet growing demands and select the right people at scale, particularly when your project needs fast hiring or when you’re looking to fill numerous positions at once.

Limited Technical Expertise

Insufficient niche expertise of tech interviewers makes it difficult to filter through qualified candidates and focus on the best ones. Eventually, this may result in missing high-quality talent.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does it take to start the interview process once we get started?

Relying on our own vast talent pool of pre-vetted candidates, backed with extensive market research – we can start scheduling and conducting technical assessments of potentially matching specialists in less than a week.

What are the benefits of interviewing candidates with a professional service provider?

Interview as a service offers several benefits (IAAS): it allows to take the best hiring decisions, ensuring efficient candidate evaluations, cost-effectiveness, and allowing companies to focus on core business. Additionally, when we run assessments on behalf of companies – we can provide significantly faster hiring, cope with huge volumes of candidate resumes, and use a variety of assessment practices for your best results.

What types of technical roles can you outsource interviews for?

There is a wide range of technical roles covered by our recruitment and technical interviews, including leadership technology (CTO, Head of Technology, Technical Project Manager, Lead Architect, Staff, and Principal Engineering roles), mid-level technology (Backend Engineers, Front-end Engineers, Full Stack Developers, Mobile Developers, Security Analysts, DevOps Engineers, Data Scientists), as well as IT support and administration (System Administrators, Database Administrators).

Can you integrate your service with our existing HR systems?

Yes, our team can help you outsource technical interviews and easily integrate our service into your existing workflow, infrastructure, or application tracking system – so that you get seamless updates in real time and have all candidates with detailed scoring and reports on a single screen.

What kind of support do you provide during the interview process?

You can outsource interviews and get a full scope of support, including interview scheduling, communication, detailed reporting, and scoring. Eventually, you receive high-quality assessments and can focus only on the best of potentially matching candidates.

How do you ensure the interviewers are up-to-date with the latest technologies and trends?

We engage our best specialists with the corresponding skill sets and seniority levels to run professional assessments of each candidate. Being a tech company ourselves, we have expert interviewers who work closely with the most demanded tech stacks and stay always up-to-date with the latest technologies, trends, and advancements in the industry.

Can we customize the interview questions and criteria to evaluate candidates more precisely?

Yes, we can help companies to focus on specific questions. Working closely with you from the very beginning, our interviewers conduct careful examination of your job requirements and analyze the scope of technical skills you need to assess. Doing so, we tailor the best interview questions and criteria to meet your specific needs and unique requirements – so that only the most fitting candidates are brought in front of you and you make a fully informed decision.

What happens if a candidate doesn’t meet our expectations?

Should it happen so, we provide valuable feedback and can quickly arrange for additional quality interviews to find the right fit for your team.

How do you handle confidentiality and data protection for our candidates?

Taking intellectual property protection and confidentiality of our clients seriously, we implement the full scope of security measures from the very beginning of our cooperation and follow the best hiring standards. We can sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) during the first encounter when you tell us about your project needs and assessment requirements.

What measures do you take to prevent bias in the interview process?

To provide a full service with an objective assessment and ensure positive candidate experience, we follow a standardized structured interview procedure and a variety of evaluation criteria to ensure every specialist is evaluated fairly and consistently, regardless of the interviewer’s subjective impressions. Additionally, we fine-tune the process to make quality interviews tailored to your core objectives and the scope of soft / hard skills you need to assess.
